fullContentHtml:
BPSC Deputy Director Online Form 2026 – Re-Open - Complete Details

Short Information : Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC) has released the Re-Open Notice for the post of Deputy Director. This recruitment has been issued for 14 posts. Online applying process for BPSC Deputy Director Recruitment 2026 will start on 02 August 2026 & the candidates can apply till 15 August 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for BPSC Deputy Director Recruitment 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 13 January 2026
  • Last Date : 03 February 2026
  • Re-Open
  • Application Start Date : 03 August 2026
  • Last Date : 15 August 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 15 August 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • All Candidates : Rs. 100/-
  • Bank Charge : Extra
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.

Important Links

  • Apply Online
  • Check Re-Open Notice
  • Download Notification
  • Official Website

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is BPSC Deputy Director Online Form 2026 – Re-Open?

BPSC Deputy Director Online Form 2026 – Re-Open is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

What is the last date to apply?

The last date to apply is 03 February 2026.

Where can I find the official website?

The official website is: https://bpsc.bihar.gov.in/

How to download notification?

Click on the relevant link in the Important Links section above or visit the official website directly.
